family_summary: Across the 28 sites, the AI-built pages mostly restyled components instead of copying them. Buttons and calls to action became rounded, filled or outlined pills in new palette colors. Empty carousels and sparse text blocks became static cards, columns or bands. Sidebar widgets, hidden forms and broken or plugin-based elements were often dropped, and a few items were kept as they were.
